subject: Renewal coordination: premium support laddering & latency targets
messages:
From: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@horizon-analytics.com>
To: rafael_mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@horizon-analytics.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Mar 2028 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal planning — premium support + latency targets

Hi Rafael,

Our renewal for the Redwood contract comes up in May. We're evaluating a move to a higher support tier and tightening our latency SLOs for inference — our internal stakeholders are asking for: 

- Premium support (24x7) with a named escalation path
- 99.95% 95th percentile latency target for production routes (current is 99.5%)
- Clear credit/rollback language for SLO misses and an onboarding checklist for ops handover

Can you share what options/price deltas you have for the renewal window? Tom (cc) will loop in procurement if we have a near-final commercial. Ideally want a draft by next week so procurement can start internal approvals.

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Jenkins
Head of Platform Ops, Horizon Analytics
[sarah.jenkins@horizon-analytics.com]

[Attachment: Horizon_usage_summary_2027_Q4.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: rafael_mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@horizon-analytics.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@horizon-analytics.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, priyom_das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Mar 2028 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal planning — premium support + latency targets

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear ask and the usage summary. Marked this high priority. Quick responses to each item and next steps below: 

- Premium support: we can offer Redwood Premium (named SE + 24x7 ops) as an add-on. Pricing is a percentage uplift on committed capacity; I will include two price bands depending on whether you take a 12- or 24-month commit.
- Latency SLO: 99.95% P95 is achievable but depends on burst profile. We recommend a dedicated reserved pool (small uplift) + an autoscale buffer for predictable tail latency.
- SLO credits and onboarding: we have a standard addendum we can redline — it contains credit bands and an ops handover checklist.

Next steps: I'll work with Marissa (CS) and Priyom (Solutions) to produce a short commercial + technical annex by Friday 2028-03-29. If procurement wants an earlier draft for internal signoff, tell me which levers (term length, commit size) you prefer.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com
Office: +1 415-555-0192

From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: rafael_mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, priyom_das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Mar 2028 09:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal planning — premium support + latency targets

Putting a recommended customer-facing approach here so we align before Rafael sends the draft: 

Proposed commercial levers (customer-friendly framing):
- Option A (12-month): +20% on their current commit for Premium support; includes named SE, quarterly business reviews, and 24x7 escalation.
- Option B (24-month): +12% on commit, includes onboarding credits (first month free Premium support) and priority capacity windows for holidays.

Operational asks to make P95 99.95% realistic:
- Move key production routes to a reserved pool for baseline capacity (small monthly surcharge).
- Add burst capacity (pay-as-you-go) that triggers automatically when tail latency signals exceed thresholds.
- Joint runbook to be authored by Priyom + Horizon ops during onboarding week.

I'll draft the SOW language for the onboarding checklist and the high-level credit table for SLO misses. Rafael — want me to include a suggested calendar for a 2-week ops handover?

-Marissa
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: onboarding_checklist_template.docx (docx)]

From: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, rafael_mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Mar 2028 11:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal planning — premium support + latency targets

Quick tech notes to support the proposal: 

- P95 99.95%: achievable if Horizon accepts the reserved-pool recommendation for routes serving interactive products. Estimate: reserved pool sized at ~1.2x current sustained concurrency.
- Burst handling: we can enable prefix/KV caching + intelligent batching for some routes to reduce token cost while lowering tail latency. Will need a short eval ramp (3–5 days) during onboarding.
- Monitoring & alerting: suggest two synthetic probes (global) and a per-route tail-latency alert. We'll supply alert templates and tracing hooks.

I'll prepare a 1-page technical annex describing the reserved-pool sizing model and the recommended alert thresholds. That should be attached to the commercial.

—Priyom
Staff Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
